package cue // import "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/lang/cue"

Package cue adds CUE and Timoni extraction to a lang.Reader. CUE is its own
package because reading it links cuelang.org/go, which a consumer that does
not read CUE should not pay for (ADR-092). Without this package a .cue file is
skipped with lang.SkipNotLinked, and Reader.Dialects leaves the CUE dialects
out.

    import "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/lang/cue"

    r, err := lang.New(cue.Option())

CONSTANTS

const Family = langlink.CUE
    Family is the name Option links.


FUNCTIONS

func Option() lang.Option
    Option links CUE and Timoni extraction into the Reader it is passed to.
